vendor_and_service: Professional tax preparation and e-file software vendor (SYS-01)
tier_rationale: Tax return information for all clients; supports High-criticality BP-01 to BP-03
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider carved out; the AI extraction sub-processor is not described (feature released after the period)
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 3 of 40 changes without documented approval; remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages user access, enforces MFA through SSO, assigns roles by least privilege, reviews user activity, and reports suspected compromise. Mapped to AC-2, IA-2(1), AC-6, AU-6, IR-6. Company gaps: activity review (POAM-006) and least privilege (POAM-002)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h; BIA needs RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h for BP-01 to BP-03: **meets, with no margin** (P05 finding 1)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice within 72 hours of confirming a security incident affecting Company data
follow_up: Obtain the AI sub-processor's identity, location, and assurance (P10); add deadline-week capacity commitments and service credits at renewal
reviewer_and_date: GRC Manager and National Tax Practice Leader, 2026-09-14

vendor_and_service: Payroll processing service (SYS-08; CAS subservice organization)
tier_rationale: Payroll data for about 8,600 client employees; supports High-criticality BP-10; moves client money
assurance_required: Annual SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity) plus bridge letter
report_type_and_period: SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2; 12 months ending 2026-06-30
subservice_organizations: Data center providers and the bank partner for ACH carved out
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: 1 of 25 tax filing changes lacked second review; quarterly user access review for one platform completed late. Remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer approves payroll changes and bank account changes, restricts and reviews user access, verifies changes requested by employees, and reviews payroll reports before submission. Mapped to AC-2, AC-5, AT-3, PS-4. Company gaps: local accounts and leavers (POAM-001), bank-change verification (POAM-024), second review (PI1.3)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 4 h and RPO 1 h; BIA needs RTO 8 h for BP-10: meets. Depends on CAS staff reaching the service (identity and endpoints)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice of a security incident within 72 hours; no explicit timing for a breach of personal information (Florida sets 10 days for third-party agents)
follow_up: Request the bridge letter; move the service to SSO; add breach notice terms; map the CUECs into the CAS control set for the Company's own SOC 2
reviewer_and_date: GRC Manager and CAS Practice Leader, 2026-09-15

vendor_and_service: Cloud accounting and bill-pay services (SYS-08; CAS subservice organizations)
tier_rationale: Client ledgers and vendor payments for about 340 clients; supports BP-11
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter

exceptions_noted: None noted in the accounting report; bill-pay report noted 1 exception on vendor bank change verification by the service's own support staff (remediated)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures approval workflows, enforces dual approval for payments and bank changes, and reviews users. Mapped to AC-5, AC-2. Company gap: single-approver bank changes (POAM-024)
availability_vs_bia: Accounting RTO 24 h, RPO 4 h; BIA needs RTO 24 h and RPO 4 h for BP-11: meets
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice without undue delay; not specific
bridge_letter: Accounting bridge letter to 2026-09-30 received; bill-pay bridge letter overdue
follow_up: Obtain the bill-pay bridge letter; turn on dual approval for all clients
reviewer_and_date: GRC Manager and CAS Practice Leader, 2026-09-15

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP) and its SIEM platform (SYS-12)
tier_rationale: Security logs that can contain customer information fragments and PHI; EDR response rights on every endpoint
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) plus bridge letter; annual service review with detection tests
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer defines log sources and use cases, maintains the escalation list, and approves containment actions. Mapped to AU-2, SI-4, IR-4. Company gaps: SaaS log sources (POAM-006) and the in-season suppression of inbox-rule alerts (POAM-007)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; breach notice within 10 days. **No BAA**, although logs can contain PHI (G-078)
follow_up: Execute a subcontractor BAA; obtain the SIEM platform's SOC 2; written IRC 6713 and 7216 notice to analysts (POAM-016)

incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice of incidents within 5 business days
follow_up: Company assessment with a site review by 2027-03-31; turnover reporting within 1 business day; right-to-audit exercised yearly
